sn21.3:1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ca sāriputto āyasmā ca mahāmoggallāno rājagahe viharanti veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe ekavihāre.
sn21.3:1.4: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā mahāmoggallāno tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā mahāmoggallānena saddhiṃ sammodi
sn21.3:1.5: …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ etadavoca:
sn21.3:2.1: vippasannāni kho te āvuso moggallāna, indriyāni.
sn21.3:2.2: parisuddho mukhavaṇṇo pariyodāto, santena nūnāyasmā mahāmoggallāno ajja vihārena vihāsīti.
sn21.3:2.3: oḷārikena kho ahaṃ āvuso; ajja vihārena vihāsiṃ.
sn21.3:2.4: api ca me ahosi dhammī kathāti.
sn21.3:2.5: “kena saddhiṃ panāyasmato mahāmoggallānassa ahosi dhammī kathā”ti?
sn21.3:2.6: bhagavatā kho me āvuso, saddhiṃ ahosi dhammī kathāti.
sn21.3:2.7: “dūre kho āvuso, bhagavā etarahi sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn21.3:2.8: kinnu kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhagavantaṃ iddhiyā upasaṅkami,
sn21.3:2.9: udāhu bhagavā āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ iddhiyā upasaṅkamīti?
sn21.3:2.12: api ca me yāvatā bhagavā ettāvatā dibbaṃ cakkhuṃ visujjhi dibbā ca sotadhātu.
sn21.3:2.13: bhagavatopi yāvatāhaṃ ettāvatā dibbaṃ cakkhuṃ visujjhi, dibbā ca sotadhātūti.
sn21.3:2.14: yathā kathaṃ panāyasmato mahāmoggallānassa bhagavatā saddhiṃ ahosi dhammī kathāti?
sn21.3:3.3: kittāvatā nu kho bhante, āraddhaviriyo hotīti?
sn21.3:3.4: evaṃ vutte maṃ āvuso, bhagavā etadavoca:
sn21.3:3.6: “kāmaṃ taco ca nahārū ca aṭṭhī ca avasissatu sarīre, upasussatu maṃsalohitaṃ. yaṃ taṃ purisathāmena purisaviriyena purisaparakkamena pattabbaṃ, na taṃ apāpuṇitvā viriyassa saṇṭhānaṃ bhavissatī”ti.
sn21.3:3.8: evaṃ kho me āvuso, bhagavatā saddhiṃ ahosi dhammī kathāti.
sn21.3:4.1: seyyathāpi āvuso, himavato pabbatarājassa parittā pāsāṇasakkharā yāvadeva upanikkhepanamattāya.
sn21.3:4.2: evameva kho mayaṃ āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa yāvadeva upanikkhepanamattāya.
sn21.3:4.3: āyasmā hi mahāmoggallāno mahiddhiko mahānubhāvo, ākaṅkhamāno kappaṃ tiṭṭheyyāti.
sn21.3:5.1: seyyathāpi āvuso, mahatiyā loṇaghaṭāya parittā loṇasakkharā yāvadeva upanikkhepanamattāya.
sn21.3:5.2: evameva mayaṃ āyasmato sāriputtassa yāvadeva upanikkhepanamattāya.
sn21.3:5.3: āyasmā hi sāriputto bhagavatā anekapariyāyena thomito vaṇṇito pasattho:
sn21.3:7.1: iti hete ubho mahānāgā aññamaññassa subhāsitaṃ sulapitaṃ samanumodiṃsūti.
